conservativePpoExperiment.name: ppo-separate-211
conservativePpoExperiment.hypothesis: Reduce policy drift caused by shared critic gradients and noisy small-minibatch optimization; initial policy unchanged.
conservativePpoExperiment.comparison: same initial policy and game schedule as plain PPO; separate critic, fresh optimizer, LR and minibatch change together, so do not attribute gain to one component.
conservativePpoExperiment.reward: terminal team +/-1 only; no teacher calls or intermediate/entropy bonuses
conservativePpoExperiment.evidence: critic-interference.json found 7.75% argmax drift from critic-only updates; separate-critic unit test proves zero initial policy change and no actor gradients from critic loss
